baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَٱلْخَامِسَةَ ... غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا ... إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: A numbered fifth speech act names God and conditionally places the speaker under intense divine displeasure tending toward requital if the implicit masculine subject's claim accords with reality.

activation_trace.role: The literal fifth and one-of-five image makes this a terminal counted act.
Intense displeasure rising toward requital supplies the consequence conditionally invoked upon her.
The divine name in oath usage identifies the transcendent guarantor and judge of the imprecation.
Occurrence or presence in time makes the sanction depend on a state actually obtaining.
Speech matching both inward intent and reported reality defines the condition of truthfulness.

changed_reading.before: A fifth statement says that wrath is upon her if he is truthful.
changed_reading.after: The fifth is a conditional self-imprecation: a counted speech act places her under divine requital only if the implicit claimant's speech matches reality.

baseline_models.mechanism: The occurrence construction and the realization branch of truthfulness keep truth from being manufactured by the utterance: the condition must obtain and be borne out before wrath follows.

activation_trace.role: Actual occurrence supplies the requirement that the conditional state obtain rather than merely be asserted.
Realization of promise or deed makes truthfulness something fulfilled and borne out, not only verbally labeled.
Retaliatory displeasure is the consequence of realized truth, not evidence that establishes it.

changed_reading.before: The condition merely repeats a claim that the implicit subject is truthful.
changed_reading.after: Truth remains a condition to be realized or borne out; wrath follows that realization rather than making the oath itself proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired four-plus-fifth sequences make her clause a counter-oath that averts present punishment without deciding the disputed fact; it transfers exposure into a conditional divine sanction, with curse for his falsehood and wrath upon her if his claim is true.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based declaration supplies the repeated evidentiary speech that precedes the first fifth.
The literal four establishes the preparatory counted layer before the terminal oath.
The paired numerical fifth marks the claimant's terminal self-imprecation.
Expulsion and distancing under displeasure supply the consequence attached to his falsehood.
Contrariety to truth defines the liability pole of the first fifth.
Punitive pain is explicitly warded from her by the counter-testimony, identifying the immediate liability displaced.
Her own numerical fifth closes the counter-sequence while preserving its distinct condition.
Active displeasure tending toward requital replaces the present human punishment with contingent divine exposure.
Correspondence of speech to reality defines the opposite condition under which her exposure becomes live.

structural_cues: 24:6 gives four attestations and a truth claim, followed by his fifth in 24:7.
24:8 says her four attestations ward punishment from her and characterize him as lying.
The two fifths are grammatically paired but invoke different consequence nouns: curse in 24:7 and wrath in 24:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two four-plus-fifth sequences, curse on him if lying, warded punishment, and wrath on her if he is truthful. I infer a transfer of present penal exposure into contingent divine liability and treat the curse/wrath contrast as meaningful; alternatively, the two consequence nouns may function as near-equivalent formulas.

changed_reading.before: Her fifth is an isolated conditional invocation of wrath.
changed_reading.after: Her fifth is the risk-bearing price of the counter-oath: it averts immediate punishment without proving him false, while placing her under divine liability if his claim is true; the paired fifths also preserve a curse-versus-wrath asymmetry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel surrounds the invoked wrath with divine surplus, tenderness, solicitation of return, and discerning judgment, preventing the conditional sanction from becoming an irrevocable identity or an unqualified final word.

activation_trace.role: Retaliatory displeasure remains the serious liability that needs contextual containment.
Favor as gratuitous benefaction supplies surplus beyond the strict liability just invoked.
Tender mercy supplies a restorative counterforce without erasing the oath's consequence.
Calling another toward repentance keeps return live immediately after the self-imprecation.
Accurate wisdom frames the handling of liability as discerning judgment rather than uncontrolled anger.

structural_cues: 24:10 follows the focus immediately with an unfinished لولا construction invoking favor, mercy, return, and wisdom.
The favor-and-mercy refrain recurs through the accusation episode in 24:14, 24:20, and 24:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency and a recurrent favor-and-mercy refrain. I infer that this refrain brackets the focus sanction and leaves restoration possible; alternatively, 24:10 may qualify the procedure or community generally rather than the oath-taker specifically.

changed_reading.before: Divine wrath reads as the terminal and exhaustive outcome named by the oath.
changed_reading.after: Wrath remains a real conditional liability, but the immediate frame withholds finality: divine benefaction, mercy, return, and wise judgment surround rather than cancel it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusation sequence first exposes mouth-borne speech without knowledge, then transfers testimony to bodily organs and intentional action, and finally has God complete and manifest the right. This defers verification beyond the litigants' oath speech.

activation_trace.role: Truth as realization or fulfillment anchors the focus condition to something that must later be borne out.
Speech that attributes what did not occur demonstrates that utterance can fabricate rather than establish reality.
The tongue as speech organ supplies the fragile human channel through which the unsupported report circulates.
The tongue-as-witness image relocates testimony from chosen allegation to the body's own disclosure.
What the hands have earned makes enacted conduct evidentiary rather than leaving truth at the level of claims.
The literal feet join the distributed bodily witness and broaden disclosure beyond the speaking mouth.
Intentional action supplies the conduct to which bodily testimony answers.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the eventual settlement of the unresolved liability.
Establishing and manifesting the right supplies the disclosure that oath repetition alone cannot produce.
Appearance and uncovering make the final truth manifest rather than merely asserted.

structural_cues: 24:15 contrasts what mouths say without knowledge with its weight before God.
24:24 makes tongues, hands, and feet testify to actions.
24:25 joins full settlement with recognition of God as the manifest truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a movement from unsupported mouth-speech to bodily testimony, action, full settlement, and manifest right. I infer that the focus conditional remains unresolved at the human speech level and awaits fuller disclosure; alternatively, the later scene may concern slanderers broadly rather than the two oath-takers narrowly.

changed_reading.before: The focus oath appears capable of settling which speaker is truthful.
changed_reading.after: The oath allocates liability while truth remains pending: bodily action later testifies, and God completes and manifests the right that ritual speech does not create.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later conditional echo joins possession of the right to willing submission before judgment. Read back into the focus, being among the truthful is tested not by assertion alone but by submitting the unresolved claim and oneself to divine adjudication.

activation_trace.role: The focus occurrence construction supplies the conditional state echoed by the later if-the-right-is-theirs clause.
Correspondence between claim and reality anchors the issue that submission is proposed to test.
Judgment between parties supplies the adjudicative destination to which disputed speakers are called.
The repeated occurrence construction introduces the closely related condition that the right actually belong to them.
A right fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the later analogue to focus truthfulness.
Submission makes the claimant's relation to judgment part of the truth mechanism.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies receptive acknowledgment of judgment.
Obedient yielding completes the posture of submission rather than argumentative self-certification.

structural_cues: 24:48 calls disputants to judgment and depicts a faction turning away.
24:49 uses a conditional construction: if the right is theirs, they come submissively.
24:51 defines the faithful response to judgment as hearing and obeying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later conditional linking possession of the right with submission to judgment. I infer that the focus self-imprecation is submission of both claim and speaker to divine adjudication; alternatively, the syntactic and thematic echo may regulate public obedience generally rather than interpret this oath directly.

changed_reading.before: The clause conditionally labels the implicit claimant truthful.
changed_reading.after: The clause conditionally submits the disputed claim to judgment: truthfulness is bound to reality and willingness to yield to adjudication, not secured by self-assertion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later rejection of maximally strenuous oaths in favor of recognizable obedience and divinely known action controls the force of the ordinal fifth: additional swearing formalizes exposure and responsibility but does not manufacture veracity.

activation_trace.role: The numerical fifth anchors the question whether one more oath can add epistemic force.
Speech corresponding to reality is the truth standard that oath intensity cannot itself guarantee.
An oath distributed among its parties supplies emphatic swearing that is explicitly told to stop.
Pushing something to the limit of exertion supplies the maximal intensity of those oaths.
The direct oath sense confirms that verbal solemnity, even at full effort, is under critique.
Obedient yielding supplies the conduct preferred over intensified swearing.
Recognition by an evident mark makes obedience inspectable rather than merely professed.
Knowledge of reports and inward reality supplies divine access beyond performed speech.
Intentional action supplies the object of divine knowledge and the alternative evidence to oath quantity.

structural_cues: 24:53 juxtaposes strenuous oaths by God with the command not to swear.
The same verse replaces oath display with recognizable obedience and closes with divine knowledge of actions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit contrast between maximal oath performance and recognizable obedient action. I infer an intra-surah limit on reading the fifth as extra proof: it adds formal liability, not truth-making power; alternatively, 24:53 concerns promised obedience, so its constraint on the legal oath is analogical rather than procedural.

changed_reading.before: The fifth can sound like an extra oath that clinches the truth of one side.
changed_reading.after: The extra oath does not manufacture truth; it formalizes exposure to consequence, while recognizable conduct and divine knowledge bear the deeper evidentiary weight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hard folded-hide branch of غ ض ب rather than replacing the direct anger sense. It remains anchored in غَضَبَ ... عَلَيْهَا and is activated by the adjacent warding of punishment plus the surah's skin-striking penalty field. Render it only as a juridical-material analogy, never as the lexical meaning of the clause.

activation_trace.role: Hard or folded hide like a shield supplies the material image of a potential burden laid upon her.
A blow landing on skin supplies the bodily legal consequence from which the later counter-oath redirects exposure.
Punitive pain is the object explicitly warded from her, furnishing the liability displaced into the invoked wrath.

changed_reading.before: Wrath is only an affective divine penalty named against her.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, accepting possible wrath 'upon her' resembles taking on a hard juridical hide: contingent divine liability becomes the shield by which immediate bodily punishment is warded away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it connects the camel-watering interval of خ م س to the thirst and mirage scene of 24:39. It remains anchored in the literal fifth and a packet-supplied shared water-cycle image. Render it as an epistemic analogy about measured expectation reaching its test, not as an etymological replacement or a claim that the focus explicitly depicts a mirage.

activation_trace.role: The fifth-day camel watering interval turns the ordinal into a measured approach toward an expected drink.
A mirage gleaming like water supplies an appearance that invites but cannot satisfy the expected arrival.
Supposition supplies the mistaken expectation, while the root's repeated occurrence in the verse links appearance to eventual reckoning.
The interval between drinks precisely echoes the scheduled watering-cycle branch activated by fifth.
Literal water supplies the hoped-for object against which appearance is tested.
Finding or encountering supplies the arrival point where expectation gives way to actual discovery.

changed_reading.before: The fifth is only the final number in an oath count.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the fifth is an arrival after a measured truth-thirst interval: repeated speech approaches its testing point as thirst approaches supposed water, where expectation yields to finding and account.

strongest_changes: The paired oath sequence turns her fifth into a transfer from immediate punishment to contingent divine liability and preserves a curse-versus-wrath asymmetry.
The immediate favor, mercy, return, and wisdom refrain brackets wrath without canceling its seriousness.
Later mouth, body, action, and manifest-right cues defer verification beyond oath speech.
The later command not to swear strenuous oaths shows that a fifth oath adds responsibility, not truth-making power.
The conditional right-and-submission sequence recasts truthfulness as yielding the dispute to judgment.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest ordinary activation was the distinction between procedural liability and epistemic proof. The packet also sustained two unusual material readings: wrath as a hard juridical hide that accompanies warded punishment, and fifth as a watering interval whose expected arrival is tested by the thirst-and-mirage sequence.
remaining_uncertainties: The curse-versus-wrath difference may be a substantive asymmetry or a formulaic variation.
Later judgment and oath passages may constrain the focus only analogically rather than define its local procedure.
The hide and watering-cycle activations are deliberately exploratory and must not displace the direct legal, affective, and numerical senses.
